data.name: Heidie
data.gender_notes: Heidie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Heidie is derived from the Old German words ‘heid’ meaning ‘happy, radiant’ and ‘ie’ meaning ‘goddess’ or ‘divine one’. The name has a joyful and uplifting meaning, reflecting the light and warmth of the sun. The name Heidie carries the meaning “Happy, Radiant One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heidie usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Heidie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, Radiant One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heidie total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
